the per-bank pattern: banks where every question carries exactly ONE OPTION-BEARING part (the past-paper MCQ shape — 0620 chem-23, 0610 bio-23, 0455 econ-20, 0452 accounting-21, the 0973 trio) ingested ZERO part rows; partial deltas elsewhere == the per-bank option-part count (9700 bio-25: 1,513 pkg -> 855 rows, delta 658 = its single-part question count)

ROOT LAW: the frozen ingest's MIXED emission (services/sme/index.ts) emits option-bearing parts as MCQ QUESTION rows (the -pK family with option rows) — only PLAIN parts become part rows. The shim's counts.parts counts ALL package parts. Information ZERO LOSS — the option parts ARE stored, as MCQ question rows; the census measured the wrong shape.

PROOF OF THE CORRECT LAW: expectedParts' = per-question (hasOptionPart ? plainParts.length : parts.length) recomputed zero-DB = 5,618 fleet-wide, PER-BANK 0-MISMATCH against the live fleet's 40 ingest lines
